upgrade_contract.identity: Preserve stable block_id and KP identity unless an explicit semantic defect requires a reviewed split/merge/renumber. Reordering for causal learner order does not itself authorize identity replacement.
upgrade_contract.lecture_first: First learning is Framework orientation -> continuous Lecture/source contact -> Logic Group/KP active Recall -> Block compression.
upgrade_contract.logic_group: A Logic Group is one continuous mechanism/judgment chain that can be learned and closed as a unit; it is not an arbitrary equal-sized slice or a second medical-Core owner.
upgrade_contract.kp_lossless: The union of canonical KPs plus required original-source visual gates must preserve stable Lecture learning value without turning KianOS into a second textbook.
upgrade_contract.timing: Current Core, Recall, Reserve, Connection Hook and Deferred content must be separated by learning timing.
upgrade_contract.precision: Precision is an accuracy attribute, not a demand that every number/drug/threshold become stable on first exposure.
upgrade_contract.source_safety: Source conflicts, uncertain claims and unsupported expansions must be explicit and adjudicated before the affected medical Core can pass.
upgrade_contract.runtime_boundary: Projection/Runtime is not redesigned per Block during this content pass. A1/A2 provide the platform reference; A3 may expose genuine system-specific needs later.
